blocks.text: pay **for**, depend **on** — qizil kitobda o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 113-dars). Bu darsda — ayblash, minnatdorlik, azob, himoya va tayanch fe'llari. Ularning ko'pchiligi **fe'l + kishi + predlog + narsa** qolipida keladi: accuse **somebody of**, blame **somebody for**, thank **somebody for**, protect **somebody from**, congratulate **somebody on**. O'zbekchada esa kelishiklar butunlay boshqacha taqsimlanadi: «o'g'irlik**da** ayblamoq», «yutug'i **bilan** tabriklamoq», «sovuq**dan** himoya qilmoq» — shuning uchun so'zma-so'z tarjima xatoga olib keladi. Predlogdan keyin fe'l kelsa — doim -ing (→ 62-dars).
of: accuse, suspect, approve, consist, die

**accuse** somebody **of** — ayblamoq: They accused him **of** lying. **suspect** somebody **of** — gumon qilmoq. **approve of** — ma'qullamoq, to'g'ri deb bilmoq; inkori **disapprove of**: Her parents don't approve **of** her boyfriend. **consist of** — ... dan iborat bo'lmoq (holat fe'li — Continuous da ishlatilmaydi). **die of / from** — ... dan vafot etmoq: of — ko'pincha kasallik (die **of** cancer), from — jarohat yoki tashqi sabab (die **from** injuries); amalda ikkalasi ham ishlatiladi. O'zbekchada «o'g'irlik**da** ayblamoq» — `-da`, «ikki qism**dan** iborat» — `-dan`, inglizchada esa ikkalasi ham **of**.

items.text: The manager **accused** Tom **of** stealing money from the till.
items.translation: Menejer Tomni kassadan pul o'g'irlash**da aybladi**.

items.text: The course **consists of** ten lectures and a final project.
items.translation: Kurs o'nta ma'ruza va yakuniy loyiha**dan iborat**.

items.text: My father doesn't **approve of** people using phones at the dinner table.
items.translation: Dadam dasturxon atrofida telefon ishlatadigan odamlar**ni ma'qullamaydi**.

blocks.text: for: pay, thank, forgive, apologise, blame

**pay (somebody) for** something — ... **uchun** to'lamoq: I paid **for** the tickets. Lekin hisob yoki pulning o'zi to'lansa — predlogsiz: **pay the bill / the rent / a fine / tax / £50**. «pay for the bill» — xato. **thank / forgive** somebody **for** — ... uchun rahmat aytmoq / kechirmoq. **apologise (to somebody) for** (→ 132-dars). **blame** uch xil qolipda ishlatiladi: **blame** somebody **for** something (aybni kishiga qo'ymoq), **blame** something **on** somebody (narsani kishiga to'nkamoq), somebody **is to blame for** something (aybdor).

rows: The driver **was to blame for** the accident.

blocks.text: **suffer from** — ... dan aziyat chekmoq, ... bilan og'rimoq: suffer **from** asthma / stress / back pain. **protect** somebody / something **from** yoki **against** — ... dan himoya qilmoq. **prevent** somebody **from** doing — ... ga to'sqinlik qilmoq (→ 62-dars). Bu yerda o'zbekcha `-dan` inglizcha **from** ga to'g'ri keladi — sifat va fe'llarda bu kamdan-kam uchraydigan moslik! So'zlashuvda «suffer with» ham eshitiladi, lekin asosiy shakl — **suffer from**.

items.text: Every spring, millions of people **suffer from** hay fever.
items.translation: Har bahorda millionlab odamlar gul changiga allergiya**dan aziyat chekadi**.
Quyosh ko'zoynagi ko'zlaringizni kuchli quyosh nuri**dan himoya qiladi**.

blocks.text: on: depend, rely, live, congratulate, compliment

**depend / rely on** — ... ga bog'liq bo'lmoq / tayanmoq, ishonmoq. depend dan keyin **what / how / whether** kelsa, **on** tushib qolishi mumkin: It depends (on) how much it costs. Qisqa javob: It **depends**. — Vaziyatga qarab. **live on** — ... hisobiga yashamoq, ... bilan kun ko'rmoq: live **on** a small pension, live **on** rice and vegetables. **congratulate / compliment** somebody **on** — ... bilan tabriklamoq / ... ni maqtamoq: congratulate her **on** her new job. O'zbekchada «yangi ishingiz **bilan** tabriklayman» deyilgani uchun «congratulate with» xatosi juda keng tarqalgan.

items.text: You can **rely on** Jasur — he always keeps his promises.
items.translation: Jasur**ga tayansangiz** bo'ladi — u doim va'dasining ustidan chiqadi.

items.text: We **congratulated** Madina **on** passing her driving test.
Students in London often **live on** pasta and toast.
items.translation: Londondagi talabalar ko'pincha makaron va qizartirilgan non **bilan kun ko'rishadi**.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «accuse in stealing» → **accuse of** stealing; «consist from» → **consist of**; «The team is consisting of ...» → **consists of**; «pay for the bill» → **pay the bill**; «blame for him» → **blame him for**; «depend from» / «It depends of the weather» → **depend on**; «congratulate with your birthday» → **congratulate on** (tug'ilgan kunda esa shunchaki **Happy birthday!**); «thank you for help me» → **thank you for helping** me.

«Kishi — o'rtada» qoidasi: accuse **him** of, suspect **him** of, blame **him** for, thank **him** for, forgive **him** for, protect **him** from, congratulate **him** on — kishi fe'ldan keyin, predlogdan oldin turadi. Faqat blame ning ikkinchi qolipida tartib teskari: blame **it on him**.

Bog'lanish: fe'l + predlog + -ing (accuse of doing, congratulate on doing, prevent from doing) — 62-dars; apologise to — 132-dars; concentrate on, insist on, spend on — 136-dars; sifat dependent on / independent of — 131-dars.

pay (sb) for, thank / forgive sb for, apologise for, blame sb for
pay **for** the meal (lekin pay the bill)
suffer from, protect sb from / against, prevent sb from
depend on, rely on, live on, congratulate / compliment sb on

examples.title: **accuse** / **suspect** somebody **of** something
examples.description: Ayblash va gumon — kishi + **of** + ot yoki -ing: accuse somebody of lying, suspect somebody of cheating. O'zbekchada `-da` (o'g'irlikda ayblamoq).

sentences.text: The police **suspect** two young men **of** breaking into the shop.
sentences.translation: Politsiya ikki yigitni do'konga o'g'rilikka tushish**da gumon qilmoqda**.

sentences.text: Are you **accusing** me **of** lying? I'm telling you the truth!
sentences.translation: Meni yolg'on gapirish**da ayblayapsizmi**? Sizga haqiqatni aytyapman!

sentences.text: The player was **accused of** cheating, but he denied everything.
sentences.translation: O'yinchi aldash**da ayblandi**, lekin u hamma narsani rad etdi.

sentences.text: Nobody **suspected** the quiet accountant **of** stealing from the company.
sentences.translation: Hech kim kamgap hisobchini kompaniyadan o'g'irlik qilish**da gumon qilmagan**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza's colleague **accused** her **of** taking credit for his work.
sentences.translation: Dilnozaning hamkasbi uni o'zining mehnatini o'ziniki qilib ko'rsatish**da aybladi**.

sentences.text: Which of the students is **suspected of** copying the essay from the internet?
sentences.translation: Qaysi talaba inshoni internetdan ko'chirish**da gumon qilinyapti**?

sentences.text: The newspaper **accused** the minister **of** wasting public money.
sentences.translation: Gazeta vazirni davlat pulini behuda sarflash**da aybladi**.

sentences.text: I hope you don't **suspect** me **of** reading your messages!
sentences.translation: Umid qilamanki, meni xabarlaringizni o'qish**da gumon qilmayapsiz**!

sentences.text: After the fire, the owner was **suspected of** starting it himself for the insurance money.
sentences.translation: Yong'indan keyin egasi sug'urta puli uchun uni o'zi yoqqanlik**da gumonlandi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod was furious when his neighbour **accused** him **of** damaging her car.
sentences.translation: Qo'shni ayol uni mashinasiga zarar yetkazish**da ayblaganda**, Bekzodning qattiq jahli chiqdi.

examples.title: **approve of**, **consist of**, **die of** / **from**
examples.description: approve / disapprove of — ma'qullamoq / ma'qullamaslik; consist of — ... dan iborat (Continuous emas); die of (kasallik) / from (jarohat, tashqi sabab).

sentences.text: My grandparents didn't **approve of** my decision to leave university.
sentences.translation: Bobo-buvim universitetni tashlash haqidagi qarorim**ni ma'qullashmadi**.

sentences.text: The team **consists of** four engineers and two designers.
sentences.translation: Jamoa to'rtta muhandis va ikkita dizayner**dan iborat**.

sentences.text: Do you **approve of** the new rules about smoking in public places?
sentences.translation: Jamoat joylarida chekish haqidagi yangi qoidalar**ni ma'qullaysizmi**?

sentences.text: A traditional Uzbek breakfast often **consists of** bread, tea, cream and jam.
sentences.translation: An'anaviy o'zbek nonushtasi ko'pincha non, choy, qaymoq va murabbo**dan iborat**.

sentences.text: Her great-grandfather **died of** a heart attack at the age of ninety.
sentences.translation: Uning katta bobosi to'qson yoshida yurak xuruji**dan vafot etgan**.

sentences.text: Some teachers **disapprove of** students using AI to write their essays.
sentences.translation: Ba'zi o'qituvchilar talabalarning insho yozishda sun'iy intellektdan foydalanishi**ni ma'qullamaydi**.

sentences.text: What does the exam **consist of**? — A written paper and an interview.
sentences.translation: Imtihon nima**lardan iborat**? — Yozma ish va suhbatdan.

sentences.text: Fewer people **die from** road accidents now than twenty years ago.
sentences.translation: Hozir yo'l-transport hodisalari**dan** yigirma yil avvalgiga qaraganda kamroq odam **halok bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: James's parents **approved of** Nilufar the moment they met her.
sentences.translation: Nilufar Jeymsning ota-onasi**ga** birinchi ko'rishdayoq **ma'qul keldi**.

sentences.text: The old city of Khiva **consists of** two parts: the inner town and the outer town.
sentences.translation: Xivaning eski shahri ikki qism**dan iborat**: ichki shahar va tashqi shahar.

examples.title: **pay for** something, but **pay** the bill
examples.description: pay (somebody) for something — ... uchun to'lamoq; pay the bill / the rent / a fine / an invoice / £20 — predlogsiz.

sentences.text: Who's going to **pay for** the repairs — you or the landlord?
sentences.translation: Ta'mir **uchun** kim **to'laydi** — siz yoki uy egasi?

sentences.text: Did you remember to **pay** the gas **bill** before we went on holiday?
sentences.translation: Ta'tilga ketishimizdan oldin gaz **hisobini to'lashni** esladingizmi?

sentences.text: Aziz **paid** the taxi driver **for** the whole journey in advance.
sentences.translation: Aziz butun yo'l **uchun** taksi haydovchisi**ga** oldindan **to'lab qo'ydi**.

sentences.text: We had to **pay** a **fine** because we parked in the wrong place.
sentences.translation: Noto'g'ri joyga mashina qo'yganimiz uchun **jarima to'lashga** majbur bo'ldik.

sentences.text: Let me **pay for** the coffee — you paid last time.
sentences.translation: Qahva **uchun** men **to'lay** — o'tgan safar siz to'lagansiz.

sentences.text: Most of my salary goes on **paying** the **rent** for our flat in London.
sentences.translation: Maoshimning ko'p qismi Londondagi kvartiramiz**ning ijara haqini to'lashga** ketadi.

sentences.text: Does the company **pay for** your English lessons, or do you pay yourself?
sentences.translation: Ingliz tili darslaringiz **uchun** kompaniya **to'laydimi** yoki o'zingiz to'laysizmi?

sentences.text: I've **paid** £300 **for** the course, so I'd better attend every class.
sentences.translation: Kurs **uchun** 300 funt **to'laganman**, shuning uchun har bir darsga borganim ma'qul.

sentences.text: Customers can **pay for** their shopping with cash, card or phone.
sentences.translation: Xaridorlar xaridlari **uchun** naqd pul, karta yoki telefon orqali **to'lashlari** mumkin.

sentences.text: If you **pay** the **invoice** before Friday, you'll get a five per cent discount.
sentences.translation: Agar **hisob-fakturani** jumagacha **to'lasangiz**, besh foiz chegirma olasiz.

examples.title: **thank**, **forgive**, **apologise for**
examples.description: thank / forgive somebody **for** something; apologise (to somebody) **for** something. Keyin ot yoki -ing: thank you for being so patient.

sentences.text: I want to **thank** everyone **for** their hard work this year.
sentences.translation: Bu yilgi mashaqqatli mehnati **uchun** hamma**ga rahmat aytmoqchiman**.

sentences.text: Will you ever **forgive** me **for** what I said at the party?
sentences.translation: Ziyofatda aytgan gapim **uchun** meni qachondir **kechirasizmi**?

sentences.text: The company **apologised for** the error and refunded our money.
sentences.translation: Kompaniya xato **uchun uzr so'radi** va pulimizni qaytarib berdi.

sentences.text: Sarah **thanked** the nurse **for** looking after her so well.
sentences.translation: Sara hamshira**ga** unga yaxshi qaragani **uchun rahmat aytdi**.

sentences.text: I'll never **forgive** myself **for** missing my daughter's first concert.
sentences.translation: Qizimning birinchi konsertini o'tkazib yuborganim **uchun** o'zimni hech qachon **kechirmayman**.

sentences.text: Should we **thank** them **for** the invitation by email or by phone?
sentences.translation: Taklif **uchun** ularga email orqali **rahmat aytaylikmi** yoki telefonda?

sentences.text: The airline **apologised to** the passengers **for** losing their luggage.
sentences.translation: Aviakompaniya yuklarini yo'qotgani **uchun** yo'lovchilar**dan uzr so'radi**.

sentences.text: Thank you **for** being so patient with me while I was learning.
sentences.translation: O'rganayotgan paytimda menga shunchalik sabr qilganingiz **uchun rahmat**.

sentences.text: Can you **forgive** a friend **for** telling your secret to everyone?
sentences.translation: Siringizni hammaga aytib qo'ygan do'stni **kechira olasizmi**?

sentences.text: Jasur still hasn't **apologised for** breaking my camera last summer.
sentences.translation: Jasur o'tgan yozda kameramni sindirgani **uchun** hali ham **uzr so'ramadi**.

examples.title: **blame** sb **for** / **blame** sth **on** / **to blame**
examples.description: Uch qolip: blame somebody **for** something; blame something **on** somebody; somebody is **to blame for** something (aybdor).

sentences.text: Don't **blame** me **for** the delay — the traffic was terrible!
sentences.translation: Kechikish **uchun** meni **ayblamang** — tirbandlik dahshatli edi!

sentences.text: The manager **blamed** the poor sales **on** the bad weather.
sentences.translation: Menejer savdoning pastligi**ni** yomon ob-havo**ga to'nkadi**.

sentences.text: Who was **to blame for** the power cut — the builders or the electricity company?
sentences.translation: Elektr uzilishi**ga** kim **aybdor** edi — quruvchilarmi yoki elektr kompaniyasimi?

sentences.text: Oliver always **blames** other people **for** his own mistakes.
sentences.translation: Oliver o'z xatolari **uchun** doim boshqalar**ni ayblaydi**.

sentences.text: Police **blamed** the crash **on** a driver who was using his phone.
sentences.translation: Politsiya avariya**ni** telefondan foydalanayotgan haydovchi**ga to'nkadi**.

sentences.text: Nobody is **to blame** — it was just bad luck.
sentences.translation: Hech kim **aybdor emas** — shunchaki omad kelmadi.

sentences.text: I don't **blame** you **for** being angry; I'd feel the same.
sentences.translation: Jahlingiz chiqqani **uchun** sizni **ayblamayman**; men ham shunday his qilgan bo'lardim.

sentences.text: Many people **blame** social media **for** the rise in anxiety among teenagers.
sentences.translation: Ko'pchilik o'smirlar orasida xavotirning ortishi **uchun** ijtimoiy tarmoqlar**ni ayblaydi**.

sentences.text: Kate **blamed** her bad mood **on** lack of sleep.
sentences.translation: Keyt yomon kayfiyati**ni** uyqusizlik**ka yo'ydi**.

sentences.text: According to the report, the builders were partly **to blame for** the collapse of the bridge.
sentences.translation: Hisobotga ko'ra, ko'prikning qulashi**ga** qisman quruvchilar **aybdor** edi.

examples.title: **suffer from**, **protect from** / **against**
examples.description: suffer from — ... dan aziyat chekmoq (kasallik, stress, muammo); protect somebody / something from / against — himoya qilmoq. Bu yerda o'zbekcha `-dan` = **from**.

sentences.text: My uncle has **suffered from** asthma since he was a child.
sentences.translation: Amakim bolaligidan astma**dan aziyat chekadi**.

sentences.text: This cream will **protect** your skin **from** the sun.
sentences.translation: Bu krem terini quyosh**dan himoya qiladi**.

sentences.text: A lot of office workers **suffer from** back problems because they sit all day.
sentences.translation: Ko'p ofis xodimlari kun bo'yi o'tirgani uchun bel og'rig'i**dan aziyat chekadi**.

sentences.text: How can we **protect** our children **from** dangerous content online?
sentences.translation: Bolalarimizni internetdagi xavfli kontent**dan** qanday **himoya qilishimiz** mumkin?

sentences.text: The region is **suffering from** a lack of rain for the third year in a row.
sentences.translation: Viloyat ketma-ket uchinchi yil yomg'ir yetishmasligi**dan aziyat chekmoqda**.

sentences.text: Vaccines **protect** people **against** many serious diseases.
sentences.translation: Emlashlar odamlarni ko'plab jiddiy kasalliklar**dan himoya qiladi**.

sentences.text: Does anyone in your family **suffer from** allergies?
sentences.translation: Oilangizda kimdir allergiya**dan aziyat chekadimi**?

sentences.text: The old walls of Khiva were built to **protect** the city **from** attacks.
sentences.translation: Xivaning qadimiy devorlari shaharni hujumlar**dan himoya qilish** uchun qurilgan.

sentences.text: After the divorce, Bekzod **suffered from** depression for almost a year.
sentences.translation: Ajrashgandan keyin Bekzod deyarli bir yil depressiya**dan aziyat chekdi**.

sentences.text: Strong passwords help to **protect** your accounts **from** hackers.
sentences.translation: Kuchli parollar hisoblaringizni xakerlar**dan himoya qilishga** yordam beradi.

examples.title: **depend on**, **rely on**, **live on**, **congratulate on**
examples.description: depend / rely on — bog'liq bo'lmoq / tayanmoq; live on — ... hisobiga yashamoq; congratulate / compliment somebody on — tabriklamoq / maqtamoq («congratulate with» emas).

sentences.text: Whether we go camping **depends on** the weather forecast.
sentences.translation: Lagerga borish-bormasligimiz ob-havo ma'lumoti**ga bog'liq**.

sentences.text: Can I **rely on** you to finish the report by Monday?
sentences.translation: Hisobotni dushanbagacha tugatishingiz**ga ishonsam** bo'ladimi?

sentences.text: My grandmother **lives on** a small pension, so we help her every month.
sentences.translation: Buvim kichkina pensiya **hisobiga yashaydi**, shuning uchun har oy unga yordam beramiz.

sentences.text: Let me **congratulate** you **on** your promotion — you really deserve it!
sentences.translation: Lavozimingiz ko'tarilgani **bilan** sizni **tabriklashga** ijozat bering — bunga chindan loyiqsiz!

sentences.text: It **depends** how much time we have; we might visit Samarkand too.
sentences.translation: Qancha vaqtimiz borligi**ga bog'liq**; Samarqandga ham borishimiz mumkin.

sentences.text: Too many people **rely on** their phones to remember everything.
sentences.translation: Juda ko'p odamlar hamma narsani eslab qolish uchun telefonlari**ga tayanadi**.

sentences.text: The guests **complimented** Madina **on** her delicious plov.
sentences.translation: Mehmonlar Madinaning mazali palovi**ni maqtashdi**.

sentences.text: For a whole month, the students **lived on** noodles and bread.
sentences.translation: Butun bir oy davomida talabalar lapsha va non **bilan kun ko'rishdi**.

sentences.text: Small farmers in the valley **depend on** the river for water.
sentences.translation: Vodiydagi kichik fermerlar suv masalasida daryo**ga bog'liq**.

sentences.text: Everyone **congratulated** Tom **on** finishing his first marathon in under four hours.
sentences.translation: Birinchi marafonini to'rt soatdan kam vaqtda yakunlagani **bilan** hamma Tomni **tabrikladi**.

examples.title: Mixed: in the news
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: of, for, from, on — yangiliklar uslubidagi gaplar.

sentences.text: The former director has been **accused of** hiding money from the tax office.
sentences.translation: Sobiq direktor soliq idorasidan pul yashirish**da ayblanmoqda**.

sentences.text: Doctors **blame** the rise in heart disease **on** poor diet and lack of exercise.
sentences.translation: Shifokorlar yurak kasalliklarining ko'payishi**ni** noto'g'ri ovqatlanish va kam harakat**ga yo'yishadi**.

sentences.text: Thousands of families **depend on** this factory, so its closure would be a disaster.
sentences.translation: Minglab oilalar bu zavod**ga bog'liq**, shuning uchun uning yopilishi falokat bo'lardi.

sentences.text: The president **congratulated** the national team **on** their historic victory.
sentences.translation: Prezident terma jamoani tarixiy g'alabasi **bilan tabrikladi**.

sentences.text: Residents who **suffer from** breathing problems should stay indoors today.
sentences.translation: Nafas olish muammolari**dan aziyat chekadigan** aholi bugun uyda qolgani ma'qul.

sentences.text: The new law aims to **protect** workers **from** unfair dismissal.
sentences.translation: Yangi qonun xodimlarni adolatsiz ishdan bo'shatish**dan himoya qilishga** qaratilgan.

sentences.text: Who is going to **pay for** the damage after the flood?
sentences.translation: Toshqindan keyin zarar **uchun** kim **to'laydi**?

sentences.text: Two men **suspected of** robbing a bank in Manchester were arrested yesterday.
sentences.translation: Manchesterda bankni o'g'irlash**da gumon qilingan** ikki erkak kecha hibsga olindi.

sentences.text: At the press conference, the minister **apologised for** the mistake and **thanked** journalists **for** reporting it.
sentences.translation: Matbuot anjumanida vazir xato **uchun uzr so'radi** va bu haqda xabar bergani **uchun** jurnalistlar**ga rahmat aytdi**.

sentences.text: Many mountain villages **rely on** a single road, which is often closed in winter.
sentences.translation: Ko'plab tog' qishloqlari yagona yo'l**ga tayanadi**, u esa qishda ko'pincha yopiq bo'ladi.
